research_question: How does the age of a continuously updated BMA posterior change next-month predictive loss when target month, calendar phase, algorithm and frozen support are held fixed?
estimand_boundary: algorithmic effect of accumulated admissible monthly history; not a universal causal effect of data quantity and not a market-level superiority claim
reason_primary_model: isolate training age from seasonal model-selection effects

validation_data.first_eligible: an untouched target year from 2025 onward with the identical monthly schema, or another untouched jurisdiction frozen before access

age_panel.definition: number of consecutive one-month prediction transitions from the seed month through the aligned target month
age_panel.seed_for_age_K: target calendar month minus K months
age_panel.calendar_alignment: K must be a positive multiple of 12, therefore every arm starts in the same calendar phase and predicts the identical target

chain_contract.seed: apply the identical frozen M0 initializer to the arm-specific seed month
chain_contract.first_transition: seed month predicts exactly seed month plus one
chain_contract.intermediate_transitions: every intermediate month is frozen, opened, adjudicated and converted into the next posterior
chain_contract.final_transition: target minus one predicts exactly the common target

matched_comparison.unit: same target month, variable, cell and frozen support across age arms
matched_comparison.support_construction: intersection computed only from each arm's information available at target minus one; target outcomes cannot define support
matched_comparison.participation: paired Brier difference for identical candidate cells
matched_comparison.quantity: paired MALE difference conditional on realized participation and pre-target matched support
matched_comparison.statistical_unit_value: paired MALE difference conditional on realized participation and pre-target matched support

uncertainty.primary: exact paired loss differences retained per target, age pair, variable and cell
uncertainty.dependence_diagnostic: two-way clustered bootstrap by flow-CN4 grouping and partner, 2000 frozen-seed replicates, reported as a 90 percent interval without p-value promotion
uncertainty.CN4_semantics: administrative grouping used for dependence control, not asserted to be a unique physical product

calendar_panel.ordinary_targets: January through November of the untouched validation year, each adjudicated separately
calendar_panel.december: predictions and posterior update preserved, primary age adjudication ABSTAIN_YEAR_END_UNCALIBRATED
calendar_panel.phase_reporting: never merge different calendar months into a primary age claim

invariants: identical software and hyperparameters across arms
identical target payload and metric across arms
one next-month freeze per arm per transition
no posterior reset within an arm
all losses, ties, abstentions and NOT_ESTIMABLE states retained
required_artifacts: one freeze, target receipt, adjudication, prior and Z_post per arm and transition

claim_and_promotion_boundary.general_training_age_law: PROHIBITED without replication beyond one source and target year
